title: Account Tradeoff Simulator and Commitment Resilience Matrix
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight simulator and accompanying resilience matrix that helps PMs and SalesOps translate competing top-account asks into defensible roadmap commitments. The simulator will surface the marginal impact of accepting a request (latency on existing work, engineering load, revenue uplift probability) and produce a resilience score representing the likelihood we can deliver with a given slack/grace allowance.

Scope:
- Input signals: account tier, expected revenue delta, legal/contractual SLA pressure, engineering effort estimate (points), cross-team dependencies, release windows.
- Outputs: tradeoff visualization (accept vs defer), suggested commitment band (Immediate / Deferred-with-grace / No-commit), resilience matrix cell (Green/Amber/Red) with recommended slack days.
- Deliverables: backend data model + scoring lambda, small React simulator UI in Console (new route: /roadmap/simulator), a lightweight API for integration with sales intake form, documentation and runbook for decision owners.

Approach:
1) Collect historic intake events (last 18 months) from intake logs and map to outcomes (on-time, delayed, rolled-back).
2) Fit a simple logistic model for delivery risk vs signals; calibrate to percentiles to produce resilience score.
3) Simulate accept/decline scenarios using Monte Carlo-style perturbations for capacity and scope creep to compute marginal impact on existing commitments.
4) Surface the minimum recommended grace (in days) required to bring cell to Green.

Success metrics (30/60/90):
- 30d: Simulator MVP in Console with synthetic dataset and working scoring function.
- 60d: Piloted with 3 account managers; 70% of simulator recommendations match panel decisions; collection of feedback to tune signals.
- 90d: Integrate with intake workflow; 25% reduction in ad-hoc escalations to execs and measurable improvement in release stability (fewer emergency rollbacks tied to prioritized account work).

Data sources: Intake forms (Sheets/Drive), JIRA/Linear timelines, GitHub PR metadata, runtime SLO incidents dashboard, CRM signal (Deal stage, ARR).

Stakeholders: Revenue Ops (Jamie Liu), Sales Engineering (Omar Rios), Eng leads for runtime (Maya Patel), Design (Ethan Cole), Legal for contractual escalation scenarios.

Non-goals: This is NOT a fully automated prioritization engine; it is a decision-support tool for PMs and EMs to negotiate commitments visibly and consistently.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Console route /roadmap/simulator renders with mock data and accepts input profile.
2) Scoring engine computes resilience score and shows recommended slack (days) for green cell.
3) Simulator can export decision summary (CSV) and record simulated decisions to intake logs.
4) Pilot run with 3 AMs yields actionable feedback; at least 5 distinct signal changes requested for tuning.
5) Documentation and runbook published to Confluence and linked in product playbook.
